Three.js 0.186.1 (MIT), from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.186.1.tgz

The downloaded package was verified against npm's SHA-512 integrity value.
scene.min.js bundles the package's core, WebGL renderer, GLTFLoader, required
geometry/skeleton utilities and Meshopt decoder with the repository's existing
esbuild. Decoder and WebAssembly bytes are local; no CDN is used at runtime.
The original MIT notice is included in LICENSE.
